title: SEC2: no efficiency issues
description:
Efficiency review (SEC2) of Phase 1 polish (08810bf):

REVIEWED CHANGES:
1. take_vars/restore_vars String keys (test-only)
   - Changed from Box::leak(&'static str) to String
   - VERDICT: More efficient — eliminates permanent memory leaks in tests
   
2. Base URL three-branch if-let fallback (lib.rs:59-66)
   - env::var called at most twice per request
   - VERDICT: No efficiency concern — env lookups are not a bottleneck
   
3. insert_if_allowed closure hoisting (events.rs:263-271)
   - Closure defined once outside loop, reused 100+ times
   - Captures: type_filter (Copy), takes owned string args
   - VERDICT: Correct optimization — zero unnecessary capture overhead

CONCLUSION: No efficiency regressions. Code shows thoughtful optimization with documented reasoning.
